tools.name: ask_mike
tools.description: Answers a plain-English question about Harcourt Valuations' published research on a covered listed mining company: its published NAV per share and price to NAV at the model date, what drives the valuation, or which companies Harcourt covers. It does not value a company at today's prices or at other

tools.name: get_published_nav
tools.description: Returns Harcourt Valuations' published net asset value per share, price to NAV, commodity, assets and model date for a covered mining company, or the whole coverage list when no ticker is given. A direct read of Harcourt's published figures: exact, fast and free. Each figure is valued at the metal p

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_mike" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Answers a plain-English question about the net asset value of a listed mining company covered by Harcourt Valuations: what it is worth, its NAV per share, its price to NAV, how its valuation moves with the gold, silver, copper or uranium price, or which companies Harcourt covers. Harcourt builds NAV" → after: "Answers a plain-English question about Harcourt Valuations' published research on a covered listed mining company: its published NAV per share and price to NAV at the model date, what drives the valuation, or which companies Harcourt covers. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
